row.notes: Builds a wide-char output path for a session results export: base dir from self+0x20 vtable (CreateDirectoryW), then name = game-mode string + '_' + local entrant team name + '_' + track name (+0xe80 or +0x220) + '_' + localtime stamp, char-mapped, plus extension from vtable+0x10. Uses GetFileAttributesW and appends a counter 1..99999 until the name is free. Good hook to redirect results file output.
